description: Start a Temporal Workflow via the temporalio SDK (gRPC). Works against local dev-server, self-hosted clusters, or Temporal Cloud.

workflow_type.label: Workflow Type
workflow_type.description: Registered Workflow class name on the worker.

task_queue.description: Task queue the target workflow's worker polls (e.g. 'etl-tq').
task_queue.label: Task Queue

workflow_args.description: Positional args passed to the workflow. If both `workflow_args` and `workflow_arg` are set, `workflow_arg` is appended.
workflow_args.label: Positional Workflow Args

workflow_arg.label: Single Workflow Arg
workflow_arg.description: Convenience for the common single-arg case.

task_timeout_seconds.description: Per-workflow task timeout (WorkflowTaskTimeout). Leaves worker-side default when unset.
task_timeout_seconds.label: Task Timeout Seconds

execution_timeout_seconds.description: Total execution timeout (WorkflowExecutionTimeout). Leaves worker-side default when unset.
execution_timeout_seconds.label: Execution Timeout Seconds

run_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout for a single run of the workflow (WorkflowRunTimeout).
run_timeout_seconds.label: Run Timeout Seconds

target_host.description: Temporal frontend host:port (default local dev-server). For Cloud: '<namespace>.tmprl.cloud:7233'.
target_host.label: Target Host

api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Temporal Cloud API key env var.

tls_cert_env_var.label: Tls Cert Env Var
tls_cert_env_var.description: mTLS client cert env var (pair with tls_key_env_var).

tls_key_env_var.label: Tls Key Env Var
tls_key_env_var.description: mTLS client private key env var.

tls_server_root_ca_env_var.description: Env var with a PEM-encoded custom root CA (rarely needed on Temporal Cloud).
tls_server_root_ca_env_var.label: Tls Server Root Ca Env Var

wait_for_result.description: When true (default), block until the workflow completes and capture its result. When false, start-fire-and-forget: the run_id lands in metadata; use temporal_workflow_sensor to observe completion.
wait_for_result.label: Wait For Result

result_wait_timeout_seconds.description: Cap on how long to wait for the workflow result (when wait_for_result=true).
result_wait_timeout_seconds.label: Result Wait Timeout Seconds
